text:
Maya Chen: Hey folks — need a quick swap for Sat 18:00–23:00 PT oncall. Family thing came up unexpectedly. Can someone take the evening slot? I can trade a Tue morning (next week) 08:00–12:00 in return.

Jin Park: I can pick up 18:00–21:00, but I have a call 21:00–22:00. Can cover 22:00–23:00 if someone else can hold 21–22.

Arman Singh: I can take the full 18–23. @Priya can you take Maya's Tue morning?

Priya Patel: Yep I can do Tue morning. Quick Q — is there anything I should watch for during the Sat evening slot (deploys, maintenance)?

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary deploy: 2025-06-14T19:00Z -> 2025-06-14T19:30Z target=redwood-13b-v2q traffic=5%

Maya Chen: Thanks all. It's a hosted canary (small %). Main thing: prewarm the model before 19:00 to avoid cold-start latency spikes for the canary probe. If canary fails it will auto-roll back and the oncall will get alert from pager.

Maya Chen: Minimal handoff notes:
- Primary contact: Arman (covering 18–23).
- Secondary: Jin (18–21, then 22–23).
- Canary window: 19:00Z (12:00 PT) — sorry timezone mix, but deploy-bot times are UTC.
- Quick checks: health /ready, 95th latency, error rate, and that fallback path works.

Maya Chen: Prewarm snippet (run once ~15m before canary):
```bash
# warm RPC path for redwood-13b-v2q
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.internal/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-13b-v2q","input":"prewarm ping","max_tokens":1}'
```

Arman Singh: Got it. I'll run the prewarm at ~18:45 PT and watch metrics. If I see 95th latency > 300ms or error rate > 1% during canary, I'll mute traffic and escalate.

Jin Park: FYI for logs/diagnostics — kube namespace is `redwood-prod`, pods: `serve-redwood-13b-*`. Basic checks: 
```bash
kubectl -n redwood-prod get pods | grep redwood-13b
kubectl -n redwood-prod logs <pod> --since=10m | tail -n 200
```
If you need to toggle a canary flag: `redwoodctl rollout set-traffic --model redwood-13b-v2q --percent 0`

Priya Patel: Noted. I'll update the rota calendar and mark Maya's Tue morning as swapped. Also leaving a quick note in the oncall runbook.

Maya Chen: Appreciate it — sorry for short notice. I'll DM Arman the extra context (test prompt sets + any customer shards to watch). :hugging_face:

Arman Singh: No worries. Sounds good. I'll take screenshots of metrics and drop them in this thread if anything looks off.

Jin Park: Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

Maya Chen: Leaving the final confirmation here: Arman covers Sat 18–23, Jin covers 18–21 and 22–23, Priya takes Tue morning. I'll update the oncall calendar now. Thanks!! :pray:
